name: Volume Exploration-Optimized INR
definition: A dual-pathway Implicit Neural Representation (INR) architecture that learns a voxel-level feature representation for volume exploration tasks, combining positional encoding with local structural context via FiLM modulation.
summary: Volume Exploration-Optimized INR is a dual-pathway architecture that combines multi-resolution hash grids with local structural encoders to capture spatial coherence for volume exploration tasks.
